answer: Standing rests on cross-examination. A seat may be asked, in a whisper, to recount a random prior exchange: the counterparty, amount and epoch. The counterparty is asked separately, so a vine of invented history forks the moment two accounts disagree. A seat whose juniper of verified exchanges cannot back the whisper loses standing for that window. Clones cannot rehearse the question because each needs genuinely independent partners whose own records align; one borrowed partner shared across forgeries tears all of them at a single mismatch. Honest work always answers from its own record.
